description: §66.3 rule 10: `<v:int=(pick(true))/>` where `pick` declares no return type and returns an `int` on one path and a `string` on the other (so its return is not proven) is E-DECL-TYPE-UNPROVEN — never silently accepted.
rationale: §66.3 rule 10: "An own value written `:T` (any type but `asIs`) whose initializer's VALUE is one whose type the compiler cannot resolve — a call of a function whose return is neither declared nor inferred-and-proven … is a compile error". ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 "go on the package" (dd own-value-type-annotation-o35d-dpa-065 §8 ruling 10; §5 item 5: the annotation "must not pass silently").

codes: severity:code 'E-DECL-TYPE-UNPROVEN' did not fire (expected severity error)
